answer: Quadratic staking erosion forces each Sybil to lock collateral scaling as n^2, so a cluster of k validators incurs O(k^2) capital while honest nodes pay linear cost. zero-knowledge verifiable delay binds slashing penalties of 1.5x stake to any equivocation, and the protocol's mirror of deposits creates a convex cost surface pushing attack spend 3.2x above maximal extractable value. hence no adversary can forge a profitable deviation, and the atlas of validator sets settles into a Nash equilibrium with negative expected utility.
